papers.title_en: Optical Fiber Sensing Technology for Sports Monitoring: A Comprehensive Review
papers.title_zh: 运动监测中的光纤传感技术：一项综合综述
papers.tldr_en: The value of OFS technology is further analyzed in areas including sports biomechanics analysis, training load monitoring, injury prevention, and rehabilitation optimization, aiming to provide a theoretical foundation for sports medicine and training optimization.
papers.abstract_en: The advancement of sports science has heightened demands for precise monitoring of athletes’ technical movements, physiological status, and performance. Optical fiber sensing (OFS) technology, with its unique advantages including high sensitivity, immunity to electromagnetic interference, capability for distributed sensing, and strong biocompatibility, demonstrates significant application potential in sports science. This review systematically examines the technical principles, innovative breakthroughs, and practical application cases of optical fiber sensors in various domains: monitoring key human physiological parameters such as respiration, heart rate, and body temperature; capturing motion and analyzing movement covering muscle activity, joint angles, and gait; integrating within smart sports equipment and protective gear; and monitoring sports apparatus and environments. papers.abstract_zh: 体育科学的进步提高了对运动员技术动作、生理状态和表现进行精确监测的需求。光纤传感 (OFS) 技术凭借其高灵敏度、抗电磁干扰、分布式传感能力和强大的生物相容性等独特优势，在体育科学领域展现出巨大的应用潜力。本综述系统地考察了光纤传感器在各个领域的技术原理、创新突破和实际应用案例，包括关键指标的监测。

papers.title_en: KineticsSense: A Multimodal Wearable Sensor Framework for Modeling Lower-Limb Motion Kinetics
papers.title_zh: KineticsSense：一种用于建模下肢运动动力学参数的多模态可穿戴传感器框架
papers.journal: Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive Mobile Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies
papers.tldr_en: KineticsSense, a multimodal framework integrating inertial measurement units and plantar pressure data to predict lower-limb electromyography signals, captures the kinetics of human motion, enhances understanding of human motion dynamics and lays a foundation for advances in rehabilitation, sports science, and human-computer interaction.
papers.abstract_en: Current human motion analysis primarily emphasizes kinematics, often neglecting underlying biomechanical factors such as muscle activation and force generation. This restricts a comprehensive understanding of movement mechanics, particularly in rehabilitation and sports science. To bridge this gap, we propose KineticsSense, a multimodal framework integrating inertial measurement units (IMUs) and plantar pressure data to predict lower-limb electromyography (EMG) signals, capturing the kinetics of human motion. By leveraging the complementary strengths of IMU-derived kinematic features and pressure-based ground reaction force estimations, KineticsSense provides a richer biomechanical representation beyond conventional kinematic analyses. papers.abstract_zh: 当前的人体运动分析主要侧重于运动学，却常常忽视肌肉激活和力生成等潜在的生物力学因素。这限制了对运动力学（尤其是在康复和体育科学领域）的全面理解。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了 KineticsSense，一个集成惯性测量单元 (IMU) 和足底压力数据的多模态框架，用于预测下肢肌电图 (EMG) 信号，从而捕获人体运动的动力学参数。通过利用 IMU 派生的运动学特征和压力数据的互补优势，KineticsSense 旨在提供更全面的运动分析。

papers.title_en: Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
papers.title_zh: 基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员临床应用中的价值：一项用于损伤预防和康复的系统综述
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing athletic performance and mitigating injury risks in sports medicine. While traditional laboratory assessments offer insights, the emergence of wearable sensor technology provides novel opportunities for objective, real-time gait evaluation in ecologically valid settings. This systematic review aims to (1) evaluate the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes (2), examine its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and (3) identify methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration. Adhering to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic search was conducted across MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase from inception to May 31st, 2025. papers.abstract_zh: 步态分析是优化运动表现和降低运动医学中损伤风险的基础。虽然传统的实验室评估提供了深入的见解，但可穿戴传感器技术的出现为在生态学有效环境中进行客观、实时的步态评估提供了新的机会。本系统综述旨在 (1) 评估基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员损伤预防中的临床疗效，(2) 考察其在康复监测和临床决策中的作用，以及 (3) 识别方法学局限性和未来研究方向。

papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 展望未来：一项关于离心阻力训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 离心阻力训练被认为是提高成年人群肌肉力量和爆发力的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚不完全清楚。目的 本系统综述旨在批判性评估离心阻力训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向）的影响。方法 从电子检索工具中检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原始期刊文章。

papers.title_en: Effects of different dietary supplements combined with conditioning training on muscle strength, jump performance, sprint speed, and muscle mass in athletes: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
papers.title_zh: 不同膳食补充剂结合体能训练对运动员肌肉力量、跳跃表现、冲刺速度和肌肉质量的影响：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
papers.tldr_en: Protein supplementation appears to be the most effective strategy for increasing muscular strength; β-alanine and creatine both improve jump performance, with β-alanine offering marginally superior effectiveness; and creatine is particularly beneficial for sprint speed.
papers.abstract_en: Background As dietary supplements have become integral to meeting athletes’ specialised nutritional requirements, research into their effects on performance has intensified. Yet inconsistent findings leave the efficacy of some supplements—most notably branched-chain amino acids and β-hydroxy-β-methylbutyrate (HMB)—open to debate. To clarify which products offer the greatest benefit, we undertook a systematic review and network meta-analysis aimed at identifying the supplements most effective for athletes, including protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, vitamin D, caffeine, and others. Methods PubMed, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, Embase and SPORTDiscus were searched from database inception to 15 March 2024 for RCTs evaluating the effects of dietary supplements (including but not limited to protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, caffeine, and vitamin D) on athletic performance. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 随着膳食补充剂成为满足运动员特殊营养需求不可或缺的一部分，对其性能影响的研究也日益增多。然而，不一致的研究结果使得某些补充剂（最著名的是支链氨基酸和 β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸酯 (HMB)）的功效仍存在争议。为了明确哪些产品能带来最大益处，我们进行了一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析，旨在识别对运动员最有效的补充剂，包括蛋白质、肌酸、β-丙氨酸、HMB、维生素 D、咖啡因等。

papers.title_en: Writing High-Quality Case Studies in Sport Science.
papers.title_zh: 撰写高质量的体育科学案例研究
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.abstract_en:
PURPOSE
Sport-physiology and -performance research often relies on group designs that compare experimental and control groups and/or preintervention and postintervention results. This commentary highlights the key elements of a high-quality case study and provides clear guidelines for readers and authors of the International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance. We propose 4 essential components. First, case studies should offer relevant and original insights by tackling novel issues and defining a clear purpose. Second, they must employ rigorous methodology, encompassing careful participant selection, comprehensive data collection from diverse sources (eg, interviews, surveys, physiological tests, training diaries, competition data), and deliberate data analysis that explicitly addresses factors influencing performance changes. papers.abstract_zh: 目的 运动生理学和运动表现研究通常依赖于比较实验组和对照组以及/或干预前后结果的群体设计。本评论旨在强调高质量案例研究的关键要素，并为《国际运动生理学与表现杂志》的读者和作者提供清晰的指导。我们提出了4个基本组成部分。首先，案例研究应通过解决新颖问题并明确目的，提供相关且原创的见解。其次，它们必须采用严谨的方法，包括仔细的参与者选择。
